title: Newmark Completes 72,000-Square-Foot Cold Storage Lease in Kent, Washington
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged a 71,613-square-foot cold storage industrial lease for Plymouth Poultry Company at 18404 72nd Avenue South in Kent, Washington.
